customer_persona: Northwind Retail — sample/fixture, no real data

views.name: v_active_customers
views.query:
SELECT customer_id, name, email
FROM `northwind-analytics-demo.sales.customers`
WHERE is_active

views.name: v_order_kpis
views.query:
SELECT order_date,
       COUNTIF(status = 'RETURNED') AS returned_orders,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(total), COUNT(*)) AS avg_order_value,
       TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(MAX(created_at), DAY) AS last_order_day
FROM `northwind-analytics-demo.sales.orders`
GROUP BY order_date

views.name: v_latest_order_per_customer
views.query:
SELECT * FROM `northwind-analytics-demo.sales.orders`
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) = 1

views.name: v_customer_tags
views.query:
SELECT c.customer_id, tag
FROM `northwind-analytics-demo.sales.customers` AS c, UNNEST(c.tags) AS tag

views.name: v_campaign_days
views.query:
SELECT campaign_id, DATE_DIFF(end_date, start_date, DAY) AS days
FROM `northwind-analytics-demo.marketing.campaigns`

views.name: v_payments_masked
views.query:
SELECT payment_id, order_id, amount, method,
       FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', DATE(paid_at)) AS paid_on
FROM `northwind-analytics-demo.finance.payments`

materialized_views.name: mv_daily_sales
materialized_views.query:
SELECT order_date, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(total) AS revenue
FROM `northwind-analytics-demo.sales.orders`
GROUP BY order_date

materialized_views.name: mv_events_by_name
materialized_views.query:
SELECT event_name, DATE(event_ts) AS day, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM `northwind-analytics-demo.marketing.web_events`
GROUP BY 1, 2

routines.name: parse_utm
routines.body:
var m = /utm_source=([^&]+)/.exec(url);
return m ? m[1] : null;

routines.name: close_month

saved_queries.name: Top products last 30 days
saved_queries.query:
SELECT p.name, SUM(i.quantity) AS units
FROM `northwind-analytics-demo.sales.order_items` i
JOIN `northwind-analytics-demo.sales.products` p USING (product_id)
GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 20

saved_queries.name: Refund rate by reason
saved_queries.query:
SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM `northwind-analytics-demo.sales.returns`
GROUP BY reason

saved_queries.name: Campaign ROI
saved_queries.query:
SELECT c.name, SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(o.total), c.budget) AS roi
FROM `northwind-analytics-demo.marketing.campaigns` c
JOIN `northwind-analytics-demo.sales.orders` o
  ON o.order_date BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date
GROUP BY c.name, c.budget

scheduled_queries.name: Refresh daily_revenue
scheduled_queries.query:
SELECT order_date AS report_date, 'all' AS dimension, SUM(total) AS metric_value,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS refreshed_at
FROM `northwind-analytics-demo.sales.orders`
WHERE order_date = DATE_SUB(@run_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY order_date

scheduled_queries.name: Refresh channel_mix
scheduled_queries.query:
SELECT CURRENT_DATE() AS report_date, channel AS dimension, SUM(budget) AS metric_value,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS refreshed_at
FROM `northwind-analytics-demo.marketing.campaigns`
GROUP BY channel
